lineageReconciliation.note: The certified P1 ref was local-only; the closure branch is anchored to the exact remote-main tree and carries the certified P0/P1/P2 commits as reviewed descendants.

responsibilityBoundary.p2Question: IS THIS PROGRAM STRUCTURALLY LEGAL TO PROPOSE?
responsibilityBoundary.runtimeAuthorityQuestion: MAY THIS EXACT ACTOR EXECUTE THIS EXACT EFFECT RIGHT NOW?

informationClassification.unclassifiedSemantics: UNCLASSIFIED is outside the lattice and is never a safe bottom value.
informationClassification.fieldPolicy: Only audited catalog or explicit declarations linked to the closed audited evidence vocabulary classify fields; unknown or unmatched fields remain unproven and fail closed.

auditedEvidence.canonical:invoice:financial:v1: existing canonical invoice schema plus audited money query catalog

rules: Internal canonical and declared governed-capability flows are legal planning flows.
Any UNCLASSIFIED external export is rejected.
External research and telemetry require an explicit declassification transform, matching authority requirement, and exact proof.
Redaction, aggregation, and tokenization do not imply declassification.
Governed communication/provider/computer flows require the destination capability; sensitive flows also require matching resource scope.
SECRET and CREDENTIAL_BOUND identity flows are rejected unless explicitly declassified with matching proof and authority requirement.

composition.Sequence: ordered structure; possible and guaranteed effect sets are deterministic unions
composition.Parallel: unordered deterministic union; conflicting writes, same-provider external mutations, and same-resource financial mutations are detected
composition.Branch: possible effects are the union with preserved case predicates; guaranteed effects are the semantic intersection only when otherwise makes the branch exhaustive
composition.Wait: READ_ONLY reversibility plus the exact required observation
composition.Compensation: conditional compensation effects link to the original effect; the original reversibility is never rewritten

reversibility.uncertaintyRule: If the audited catalog cannot prove a classification, P2 emits UNKNOWN; optimistic declarations are rejected.

authorityRequirements.vocabulary: Existing action:<operation> and query:<intent> vocabulary plus existing runtime risk/approval/spend/resource concepts.

rules: Existing canonical targets require explicit existence/entity preconditions.
The exact intendedState is retained in ensures.
Every existing required observation remains in observes.
Execution-time grounding, versions, values, policy, authority, and precondition checks remain mandatory.

resolution.trustedTenantSource: StaticResolutionContext supplied by authenticated runtime; no tenant field exists in model-authored IR.
resolution.entities: Validate canonical type vocabulary, then tenant-scoped existence, tenant equality, actual type, and available freshness evidence. Cross-tenant, missing, stale, and mismatched targets reject; ambiguous/unresolved targets remain UNRESOLVED.
resolution.capabilities: Resolve audited query/action capability existence and effect-dimension compatibility; external/computer effects require configured bindings.
resolution.computerBinding: The exact business application is matched against an active application account and active auth profile; browser/session details never enter IR.

productionShadow: same-candidate Operational Query with tenant-scoped read-only entity/capability resolution
shadowAndEnforcement.enforcementRule: Only explicit enabled operations reject proven REJECTED programs; UNRESOLVED defers; ADMISSIBLE continues to existing BusinessEffect and runtime Authority.
shadowAndEnforcement.cutoverReason: The certified P1 production action planner does not yet emit complete same-candidate OperationalProgram desired-state declarations; fabricating them would violate the P1 adapter boundary.

runtimeOnlyOrUnsupportedSeams: Current actor authority, policy decision, approval chain, and spend balance are runtime-only.
BusinessEffect identity, current target snapshots/version hashes, dispatch results, provider uncertainty, reconciliation, receipts, and execution verification remain runtime-only.
Provider health/scopes and resource-level account selection beyond statically exposed configured bindings remain runtime-only.
Canonical staleness is rejectable when the resolution provider exposes it; the current canonical tenant lookup proves existence/tenant/type but has no universal freshness contract.
Static multi-node Objective/Branch/Parallel/Compensation lowering remains unsupported by the existing P1 lowerer.
Operations outside the audited action/query catalogs remain UNRESOLVED.
p3Deferrals: Acquire or clarify unresolved and ambiguous entity references without guessing.
Acquire missing field classifications and exact declassification evidence; P2 keeps them UNCLASSIFIED/UNRESOLVED.
Observe live provider state, account health, scopes, freshness, and post-execution outcomes.
Enrich production action planning candidates with explicit same-candidate desired-state/effect declarations before broad action cutover.
